sources.name: OS MasterMap Topography Layer Documentation
sources.role: national topographic feature, TOID, update and access-role contract
verified_facts: OS MasterMap Topography Layer represents more than 500 million uniquely identified real-world objects across Great Britain and is updated every six weeks.
semantic_limits: Topographic detail and positional accuracy do not establish legal ownership boundaries or parcel terrain extrema.

sources.name: OS MasterMap Topography Layer Overview
sources.role: feature identity, coverage, point-line-polygon and product-role contract
verified_facts: The overview describes physical and intangible features represented as points, lines and polygons with persistent topographic identifiers.
semantic_limits: A TOID identifies an OS topographic feature and must not be substituted for an HMLR title identifier or EA elevation sample.

sources.name: OS MasterMap Topography Layer Product Themes
sources.role: nine-theme classification and multi-theme attribution contract
verified_facts: The product overview groups Topography Layer content into nine themes covering built, natural, transport, water and administrative content.
semantic_limits: Theme membership is classification metadata; it does not prove geometry completeness, legal extent or vertical datum.

sources.name: OS MasterMap Topography Layer Product Details
sources.role: scale, object representation and real-world-object catalogue contract
verified_facts: The product details distinguish feature representations and direct users to the real-world object catalogue for representation rules.
semantic_limits: A catalogue definition or display scale is not a source-byte receipt and does not improve parcel measurement accuracy.

sources.name: OS MasterMap Topography Layer Product Supply
verified_facts: Product handling depends on data volume, available resources, infrastructure and the target GIS or database applications.
semantic_limits: A successful import or display does not prove that all expected features, versions or update history were loaded.

sources.name: Topography Product Supply Mechanism and Options
sources.role: full-supply, change-only update, geographic and non-geographic chunk contract
verified_facts: The product supports Full Supply and Change-Only Update options, with format- and order-dependent chunking mechanisms.
semantic_limits: A COU or chunk is not a complete current holding unless it is applied to the correct compatible base and reconciled.

sources.name: Topography Updating Data Holdings
sources.role: continuous revision, change-since date and managed-set contract
verified_facts: The underlying database is continuously revised and COU selection is based on changes after the supplied change-since date.
semantic_limits: A current service date does not prove that a local holding applied every prior update without gaps or duplication.

sources.name: OS MasterMap Topography Layer Technical Specification
sources.role: feature model, lifecycle, TOID integration, format and metadata contract
verified_facts: The specification defines identifiable persistent features, real-world lifecycle rules, layer integration through TOIDs and GML, GeoPackage and vector-tile formats.
semantic_limits: Specification conformance does not prove a particular distribution was downloaded, complete or suitable for height measurement.

sources.name: Topography File Naming
sources.role: GeoPackage, vector-tile and GML package-name and feature-file contract
verified_facts: GeoPackage and MBTiles supplies contain separate files for six feature types, while GML supplies use geographic or volume-based chunk names.
semantic_limits: A valid filename is routing metadata only and must not be accepted as proof of file content, version or completeness.

sources.name: Topography Feature Types
sources.role: six feature types, BNG geometry and departed-feature update contract
verified_facts: The specification defines topographic, boundary and cartographic feature types and represents COU movement or deletion through DepartedFeature records.
semantic_limits: Cartographic text and symbols are portrayal features; DepartedFeature records require ordered update processing and cannot create terrain values.

sources.name: Topography Topology
verified_facts: The product uses topography, landform, pylons and boundaries structuring layers and maintains coincident vertices where features should share geometry.
semantic_limits: Topological consistency inside the product does not establish cadastral authority or exact legal boundary position.

sources.name: Topography Seamless Data Supply
sources.role: selection polygon, unclipped overlap and temporary inconsistency contract
verified_facts: The product is seamless; features overlapping a nominal selection boundary are supplied in full, and update timing can temporarily create inconsistent neighbouring features.
semantic_limits: Selection coverage must be checked using feature geometry and versions; package edges must not be treated as real-world boundaries.
